svg.text: The observed beauty stack — what actually builds the Triangle Strategy read
Order is the finding: base layers are authored first; effects "build it up" (Asano, 4Gamer). Right column: who owns it in Genesis today.

g.text: L1 · Compact board + 2–4 broad masses + one spatial sentence
FFT ancestry · median 120 cells · hierarchy before detail
Genesis: composition compiler (specced, C1H gate)
L2 · Real geometry for every affordance; causal joins; thickness
retain / foot / cut / spill · crisp architecture, rounded landform
Genesis: proven (CL-F05, natural-surface default)
L3 · Pixel-DNA surfaces: hand-dotted texture families on the 3D forms
Morimoto: environment textures are dot art · sprite and world share substance
Genesis: sprite-first materials ruled; 2 parents live — THE GAP
L4 · Full-range value + saturated material identity + palette discipline
measured: FFT/IC highlights hit 85–100; Genesis frames cap ≤75 — headroom gap
Genesis: realm palettes exist; value ceiling unclaimed
L5 · Lit citizens: sprites receive scene light/grade; grounded contact
TS artist adjusted palettes for lighting (white overexposes) · contact + cast shadows
Genesis: built (Lambert + emissive floor + contact/cast)
L6 · Motivated practicals + atmosphere (fog, weather, particles)
owned emitters · weather states per scene · depth fog separates bands
Genesis: built (torch recipes, fog whisper, celestial)
L7 · Photographed-miniature framing: tilt-shift DoF, bloom, grade, vignette
the diorama cue (Ito 1997: "miniature garden") · action sharp, world soft
Genesis: built (BW3 suite, 125–165 fps)
L8 · World context beyond the edge: apron, mid-field, far premise
TS/IC continue the world; FFT's black void is the one ancestor to reject
Genesis: contract ruled (4 bands); nothing built

svg.text: authoring order: base first, effects build up
Coordination is the point (H2): no single layer carries the look — L3+L4 are the layers Genesis has not yet claimed; L1 is compiler work; the rest is built.
Original diagram derived from study findings. No traced game content. Research only — nothing here is a ruling.
